description: Spec §5.4, per car (SEDAN, BRUTE and VIPER side by side on the drive strip, raw AI controllers): 0.5 s after spawn EngineAudio's sound is the car's EngineSound (the catalogue's SW_DF_Engine*), it auto-activates, and it is playing (asserted when the world has an audio device, GetMaxAudioChannelCount > 0; a -nosound run has none, so there the sound, auto-activation and multipliers stand in); at rest its volume is 0.35 and SkidAudio (SW_DF_Skid) is silent. After 3 s at full throttle the engine pitch multiplier is above 1.0 and its volume 1.0, and a 1000 cm/s sideways kick turns the SEDAN's skid volume up. Physics in step with game time (time dilation 0.25).
